newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving in narrow range.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may move in a narrow range as investors are likely to trade cautiously in the absence of fresh incentives, brokers said.

"Share prices are expected to move in a narrow range because I don't see any strong fundamental that can push the market up. But the market will be active as investors' sentiment remains still high due to the overall positive investment climate," said broker Sabbir Ahmed said
Brokers said there might be profit-taking on scrips like Apex Foods and cement shares.

Broker Shakil Rizvi said: "The market should stabilise now after a rally. The investors will be careful in making further commitment. We support the steady growth since it is a healthy sign for the market."
Brokers said blue chips in engineering and financial sectors might attract investors and could rise slightly.
The DSE all share price index closed 21.4 points or 1.79 percent up at 1,217.74 on a turnover of 117.94 million taka on Saturday.
